pinned_inputs.regenerate_with: python -X utf8 benchmarks/battery_flagship_b3/audit/prepare_b3.py (deterministic; must reproduce both digests)

what_was_already_known_when_this_was_wri: B1: affine chord RMSE 215.27 mV on BATT_001 {0, 0.4, 0.6}, inadequate
B2: degree-2 curve RMSE 212.62 mV, 0/3 coverage, inadequate; POLY2 0 residual dof; TAB5 rank 3/5
the whole Jahn discharge and charge branches were inspected as numbers for the Phase 7 audit (values, monotonicity, hysteresis sign, quantisation). No model has been fitted to them.
the region boundaries and the T5/T6 knot positions below were chosen by the author after that inspection; they are declarations, not fits, and CV (not held-out error) selects among models

phase6_voltage_meaning.meaning: interrupt-relaxed voltage after a rest of UNDOCUMENTED duration: pseudo-OCV. Never called equilibrium OCV. Not loaded terminal voltage (record: 'current interrupts'; Phase 7: the branch lies on the relaxed side of the C/20 loaded discharge curve at 90/90 compared points).
phase6_voltage_meaning.charge_branch: kept distinct; outside battery.cell.rint_ocv's claim (discharge only, no hysteresis); used ONLY for the Phase 21 hysteresis measurement; never calibrated, never pooled
phase6_voltage_meaning.shared_top_row: row 101 duplicates row 100 (charge top); it belongs to the charge branch and is not a discharge observation
phase6_voltage_meaning.state_of_charge: z = Q / Q_top, Q_top = 1.00621822243387 Ah (row 100). Used as the declared target SOC of each discharge condition

fixed_declarations_for_the_battery_adapt.why_these_do_not_matter_and_how_that_is_: the scored observable is open_circuit_voltage at the conditioned z, which the Rint closed form does not take from capacity, resistance, current or temperature. Capacity 1.1 Ah is the 18650M1A nominal; resistance is BATT_001's declared 12.6 mOhm (same cell model); the current is a placeholder because the step current is undocumented. A test asserts the OCV prediction is bit-identical when each is changed.

phase8_uncertainty_model.combination: root-sum-square of independent standard uncertainties, per observation

terms.acquisition: BaSyTec CTS voltage accuracy 1 mV, rectangular half-width: 1/sqrt(3) = 0.577 mV
terms.quantisation: measured 190.88 uV code step, uniform: step/sqrt(12) = 0.055 mV
terms.temperature: 0.2 mV/K x 2 K = 0.4 mV (B1's generous entropic figure; chamber stability undocumented, band declared)
terms.state_of_charge: |dV/dz| x 0.0033/sqrt(3); |dV/dz| from the nearest CALIBRATION observations bracketing the point (never the point itself, never a held-out voltage), one-sided from the two nearest calibration points at the ends
terms.residual_relaxation_allowance: 10.3 mV uniform: the median of BATT_001's measured V(24 h) - V(10 min) over its five interior discharge-conditioned levels {19.2, 12.1, 8.0, 8.4, 10.3} mV (same cell model, independent lab); 10 min is the only rest length documented in this record's time series

phase8_uncertainty_model.resulting_range: 10.3 mV on the plateau to 28.0 mV at the steepest held-out knee point (OBSERVATIONS.json carries every term)
not_used: B1/B2's NI USB-6251 or ACS724 figures (different instruments)
known_limits: relaxation incompleteness is a smooth systematic bias in reality, modelled as independent noise
the knee-interior relaxation is unknown; the uniform allowance may understate it there

sensitivity_ladder_preregistered.what_is_rerun_per_rung: all sigmas recomputed with that allowance; every gate-passing model re-calibrated through the frozen calibrate; held-out scored with the exact linear-Gaussian predictive (route DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN, see phase12). Core grids run at the primary rung only.
sensitivity_ladder_preregistered.reported: per model and region, the verdict at each rung and the smallest rung at which it is adequate
sensitivity_ladder_preregistered.verdict_bearing: no; only the primary rung (10.3 mV) carries the verdict. The ladder states how robust it is.

phase9_split.rule: order the 100 discharge observations by ascending z; index i = 0..99; held out iff i % 3 == 1
phase9_split.why_interleaved: a deterministic SOC-structured split that puts held-out points in every region while leaving calibration able to see every region. It tests interpolation at 1 % resolution, which is what a declared OCV curve is used for; it does not test extrapolation beyond the measured range.

phase10_leakage_controls.split_machinery: engcore.inference.ObservationSplit.partition (frozen), by condition identity; disjointness also proven by observation_content_digest
held_out_values_never_enter: knot or node POSITIONS (declared constants below)
knot or node voltages (fitted to calibration only)
initial point (declared constant: linspace(3.0, 3.4, p) V)
grid centre and span (calibration-only weighted least squares)
phase10_leakage_controls.representation_that_needs_held_out_value: T-CAL (knots at every calibration z, plus 0 and 1) is included ONLY to show the gate refusing it (p = 69 >= n_cal = 67). A table whose knots are the measurements themselves including held-out points is HONEST_HELD_OUT_NOT_POSSIBLE_FOR_THIS_REPRESENTATION and is not built.

phase11_models.existing_forms_only: PolynomialNodeParameterization and TabulatedKnotParameterization, both already in engcore.domains.battery.calibration; no new form, interpolation or physics

routes.CORE_GRID: frozen gaussian_grid_posterior + assess_identifiability + posterior_predictive_uq + assess_predictive_observation over an AdmittedForwardTable of production-solver predictions; axis-aligned tensor grid centred on the calibration-only WLS estimate
routes.DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN: for p too large for any feasible grid. Both forms are exactly affine in their voltages through the production solver (checked by test to 1e-12 V). With a flat prior and Gaussian noise the posterior is then exactly N(theta_WLS, (J^T W J)^-1), J taken by finite differences through the adapter; identifiability applies the frozen assess_identifiability THRESHOLDS (width 1.0, correlation 0.95, condition 1e6) to that covariance; predictive total variance = J_h Sigma J_h^T + sigma^2. Labelled NOT Core-certified wherever it appears.
routes.route_cross_check: every CORE_GRID model is also run through DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN. The domain route may carry a claim only if, on every CORE_GRID model, posterior means agree within 0.1 posterior sd, posterior sds within a ratio 0.85..1.15, and held-out total predictive sds within 5 %. Otherwise every DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN result is reported as UNVALIDATED and cannot carry the verdict.

grid_rule.on_GridResolutionError: reported as GRID_TOO_COARSE_FOR_INFERENCE; the model's Core identifiability is then unknown and it cannot pass the gate on the CORE_GRID route
grid_rule.execution: forward rows may be computed in worker processes; rows are merged in grid order before the frozen table constructor; parallelism has no statistical effect

phase11_models.controls_of_b1_b2: P1 is the affine chord form of B1 (a degree-1 curve through nodes 0 and 1 is the chord, B2 proved to 1e-12); P2 and T3 are B2's POLY2 and TAB3 forms

phase12_gate.structural: p < n_cal AND rank(J_cal) == p, rank by numpy.linalg.matrix_rank default tolerance on the sigma-weighted calibration Jacobian
phase12_gate.statistical: identifiability status IDENTIFIABLE (CORE_GRID: frozen assess_identifiability; DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN: the same thresholds on the exact covariance)

phase13_parameterization_sensitivity.polynomials: node voltages (primary) versus ascending monomial coefficients about 0 (linear map through the Vandermonde matrix)
phase13_parameterization_sensitivity.tables: knot voltages (primary) versus anchor + increments (v0, v1 - v0, ..., vk - v(k-1))
phase13_parameterization_sensitivity.method: the same posterior mapped linearly; CORE_GRID models by transforming grid points and re-running the frozen assess_identifiability (its spacing check is then uninformative and says so); the width/correlation/condition rule applied in both parameterizations
phase13_parameterization_sensitivity.reported: status in each parameterization for every gate-passing model, and whether it changes

phase15_held_out.adequacy_rule: chi-square of standardized held-out residuals (total predictive sd) on n_held = 33 dof; p < 0.01 => MODEL_INADEQUATE. B1's rule, reused.
phase15_held_out.empirical_adequacy_beside_it: engcore.domains.battery.empirical.assess_ocv_empirical_adequacy on the held-out points with the calibrated estimate as the declared curve and measurement u only; reported, never merged with the rule above

phase16_regions.per_region: n, RMSE, MAE, worst error, standardized residuals, coverage, region chi-square on n_region dof, p < 0.01 => region inadequate

phase17_complexity_and_selection.cross_validation: 5 folds over the 67 calibration observations: fold k = calibration observations whose rank in ascending z is congruent to k mod 5. Each fold: frozen calibrate on the other four folds, predict the fold through the adapter, score = mean squared standardized residual (calibration sigmas).
phase17_complexity_and_selection.eligibility: gate-passing on the full calibration set AND structurally identifiable (p < n_train, rank == p) in every fold
phase17_complexity_and_selection.selection: BEST HONEST MODEL = the eligible model with the lowest mean CV score; if another eligible model is within 1 % of it, the one with fewer parameters
phase17_complexity_and_selection.reported: complexity vs calibration RMSE vs CV score vs held-out RMSE for every gate-passing model, and the held-out-best model labelled as post hoc

phase23_verdict_mapping_fixed_now.A_EXISTING_CURVE_ADEQUATE: the best honest model is ADEQUATE at the primary rung globally AND in every region
phase23_verdict_mapping_fixed_now.C_RICHER_CURVE_OVERFITS: not A, and the best honest model's held-out RMSE exceeds that of a LESS complex gate-passing model of the same family by >= 20 %, or a less complex gate-passing model is adequate where it is not
phase23_verdict_mapping_fixed_now.B_EXISTING_CURVE_IDENTIFIABLE_BUT_INADEQ: not A and not C, and the best honest model is gate-passing. If some MORE complex gate-passing model is adequate globally and in every region, this is recorded as ADEQUATE_ONLY_AT_A_COMPLEXITY_CV_DID_NOT_SELECT beside B
phase23_verdict_mapping_fixed_now.D_DATA_STILL_INSUFFICIENT: no model is CV-eligible, or the split cannot be built as preregistered
phase23_verdict_mapping_fixed_now.domain_route_condition: if the best honest model is on the DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN route and the route cross-check failed, the verdict is D

final_verdict_strings.A: BATTERY B3 COMPLETE — EXISTING OCV CURVE EMPIRICALLY ADEQUATE
final_verdict_strings.B: BATTERY B3 COMPLETE — EXISTING OCV CURVE STILL INADEQUATE
final_verdict_strings.C: BATTERY B3 COMPLETE — CURVE COMPLEXITY OVERFITS HELD-OUT DATA
final_verdict_strings.D: BATTERY B3 BLOCKED — REAL DATA INSUFFICIENT

phase23_verdict_mapping_fixed_now.scope_of_any_verdict: an interrupt-relaxed pseudo-OCV of one A123 18650M1A cell at 25 degC, discharge-conditioned, at the primary relaxation allowance; never the cell's equilibrium OCV

secondary_not_verdict_bearing.phase21_hysteresis: charge branch linearly interpolated at each discharge z; charge - discharge per region; compared with the best honest model's held-out residual magnitude per region
secondary_not_verdict_bearing.phase22_cross_cell: the best honest model's calibrated curve, unchanged, scored on BATT_001's 24 h discharge OCV {0, 0.2, 0.4, 0.5, 0.6, 0.8} with B1's sheet-wide sigma rule via assess_ocv_empirical_adequacy => PARAMETERS_GENERALIZE or not. Refit of the same form on BATT_001 only if p < 6 and then with no held-out left, so REPRESENTATION_GENERALIZES is recorded as untestable on six points unless p <= 3 allows a 3/3 split. Disclosed confounds: different labs, rests (24 h vs undocumented), SOC definitions (nominal-capacity coulomb count vs Q/Q_top)
secondary_not_verdict_bearing.phase24_next_physics: only under verdict B: rank candidates by measured magnitude relative to the best honest model's held-out residuals per region; hysteresis from the charge branch; relaxation from the ladder; temperature and rate cannot be assessed (one temperature, undocumented current) and are recorded as NO_EVIDENCE

synthetic_controls_before_measured_data.in_model: truth = T5 at declared voltages, observed at the real z grid with Gaussian noise at the real sigmas (seed 20260913): expect gate pass, chi-square adequate
synthetic_controls_before_measured_data.knee_misfit: truth = a declared analytic knee-plus-plateau V(z) = 3.30 - 0.62 exp(-z/0.018) + 0.06 (z - 0.5) V with the same noise: P2 must be inadequate with its worst held-out error in KNEE
synthetic_controls_before_measured_data.route_agreement: on the in-model control, CORE_GRID and DOMAIN_LINEAR_GAUSSIAN agree within the route_cross_check tolerances

core_boundary.core_gap_watch: if a claim genuinely requires a generic Core capability that is missing, it is reported as CORE_GAP_CANDIDATE and the Core is not modified
